scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: Fifty-five units, hundreds of words, one amazing team. Congratulations, explorers — you're ready for Flyers!
scene.intro: Fifty-five units, hundreds of words, one amazing team. The Aurora graduation ceremony begins at six: certificates on the table, the hall full of families, and Kili — who has never been on time in his life — waiting at the door with the diplomas. Ingrid, Diego, Maya and Oliver remember every adventure, from the first suitcase to this evening. They are proud. And so should YOU be. Congratulations, explorer!

activities.title: Listen to the graduation ceremony. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: todo el elenco — ceremonia emotiva y divertida.
data.script: Diego: Welcome to the Aurora graduation ceremony, live from the school garden! … Ingrid: Explorers, you learned hundreds of words and you never gave up. … Maya: Scientifically speaking, your brains are now two sizes bigger. … Oliver: This song is for you. It's called Ready to Fly! … Diego: The head teacher is giving out the certificates. Blue ribbon, gold letters! … Ingrid: And the last certificate is for… Kili! Best mascot in history. … Diego: Kili is crying happy tears. Condors do that, apparently. … Ingrid: One, two, three… CONGRATULATIONS, EXPLORERS!

The girl with fair hair and a dark blue jacket. … Maya: That is Ingrid. Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the boy in the red shirt with a microphone? … Maya: That is Diego. Look, Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass? … Maya: That is Maya. Look, Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the boy with red hair and a yellow shirt? … Maya: That is Oliver. Look, Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter.
